predecessors.name: Zubayrid Caliphate
predecessors.text: Kufa and most of Iraq, with the Jibal and Azerbaijan

successors.name: Zubayrid Caliphate
successors.text: Kufa, Iraq and the Jibal and Azerbaijan

rulers.name: Mukhtar al-Thaqafi
rulers.title: leader of the Kaysanites, avenger of Husayn

ledger.x: 18-19 Oct 685: Mukhtar page: the plan to seize Kufa was fixed for 'Thursday, 19 October 685'; his forces defeated the Zubayrid garrison on 18 October and Kufa gave him its allegiance the next morning.

Oct 685 on: Second Fitna page: Mukhtar held 'most of Iraq and parts of north-western Iran'; the Mukhtar page: after taking Kufa he 'controlled most of Iraq and its dependencies including Arminiya' and gave Mosul and al-Mada'in to Arab governors.
17 Jul 686: Mukhtar page: Mukhtar's cavalry 'defeated an Umayyad army near Mosul' on 17 July 686, which opens the war with the Umayyads under Ibn Ziyad.
687: Mukhtar page: Mus'ab attacked Kufa, defeated the Kufans at Madhar and Harura, 'then besieged Mukhtar's palace for four months'.
3 Apr 687: Mukhtar page: 'On 3 April 687 Mukhtar came out of the palace with nineteen supporters' and was killed in Kufa; Mus'ab took the palace.
3 Apr 687: the siege of Mukhtar's palace ends with his death.
3 Apr 687: Mukhtar dead, 'ruled for eighteen months'; his followers are called the Kaysanites.

wars.name: Second Fitna
wars.outcome: Umayyad victory in the war as a whole; Mukhtar's regime was crushed by the Zubayrid governor of Basra on 3 April 687.

certainty.note: The pages give a list of provinces under his governors, not borders; north-western Iran, Arminiya and the Jazira are unlocated.
